title: 日本ダービーの後に・笑い泣きの栄冠

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I won? I won the Japanese Derby?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh wow… The gods really came in clutch today. Personally, woulda preferred their favor when I was growin' up, but…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A victory here should have me bouncin' off the walls with joy. The fam's gonna be over the moon…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So, how come… How come I…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer… I won, y'know? I was all beat up, but I went 'n won the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But instead of feelin' happy, I feel way more…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Relieved… I was shakin' like a leaf seein' all those tough runners, but I still won.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's a big deal, right? Right? So then why do I feel so… pathetic?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Folks only get one shot to win the Derby 'n I seized mine. I should be celebratin' like there's no tomorrow. Hehe… Hehehe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross forces herself to laugh, but I can see her legs trembling. The fear, adrenaline and exhaustion have clearly gotten to her.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Something tells me this isn't the time to chat. Talk about a heavy atmosphere…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: In that case, I just say it from here.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Tamamo. Your running today was spectacular.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even while hurting deeply on the inside, Tamamo Cross accomplishes a tremendous feat. She will forever be etched into history as a Derby champion.
